paper_metadata.title: Experimental investigations into the effect of low-temperature milling process on burr morphology, chip morphology and tool wear for CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy
paper_metadata.journal: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

evidence.quote: CoCrFeNiMn high-entropy alloy (HEA) produces a large number of burrs and leads to rapid tool wear by conventional milling due to its high plasticity and strength.
the high entropy alloy material is CoCrFeNiMn
This paper investigates the effect of room-temperature milling and low-temperature milling work on the cutting performance of HEA and analyses the evolution of chips, burrs and tool wear.
